rulings.ruling: Ruling: equivalent; project retained. The project enters zero when box 10 is zero and box 10 less the part reported in box 1 (not below zero) otherwise; with box 10 zero the second's subtraction is also zero. The project refuses a part reported in box 1 above box 10 (w2.box10_bad, on w2.dc_net), as the second's note proposes. i2441 p. 5, Line 12, "don't include amounts reported in box 10 that exceed your plan's exclusion and are therefore reported as wages in box 1 of Form(s) W-2".

Ruling: scope; project retained. The second adds code H; the project refuses a Form W-2 with a code H amount (w2.code_h on w2.sav_listed, owner decision 2), because those contributions are deducted on Schedule 1, which this tool does not prepare (iw2w3 p. 20, Box 12—Codes, "Code H—Elective deferrals under section 501(c)(18)(D) tax-exempt organization plan ... The employee will deduct the amount on their Form 1040 or 1040-SR"), although f8880 p. 2, Line 2 counts "Contributions to a 501(c)(18)(D) plan". The project's code G guard (box 12 code G above zero) changes nothing: with code G zero, an elective part above zero is refused (w2.g_bad).
